name: Parus
text_1: A serene home away from home, Parus was envisioned as a winter escape on Palm Jumeirah for a large, multi-generational family to experience the essence of a holiday in one sanctuary, where they can reconnect, relax, and recharge.

Natural travertine stone cladding, accented with anodised bronze profiles and decorative mesh screens, gives Parus’s exterior façade a striking uplift. Clean lines, refined tones, and textures echo the coastal setting, inviting skyline and sea into the home through expansive glazed panels.
text_2: A double-height entrance lobby, anchored by a grand bronze pivot door, sets a tone of understated elegance. Inside, the villa unfolds around a light-filled foyer, where full-height Vitrocsa sliding glass doors frame uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf.

Balancing flexibility and flow, interconnected formal and family spaces are defined by concealed sliding pocket doors, allowing the layout to shift seamlessly between vibrant social zones and personal, private retreats. An upstairs family lounge provides a communal space for relaxation, adjoining six bedrooms, each with private balconies and panoramic vistas.
text_3: Outdoor life is at the heart of Parus; a 21-metre infinity pool stretches along the beachfront, blending the boundary between villa and sea. Expansive terraces and landscaped gardens share a series of spaces for dining, lounging, and play.

Designed with family, function and form as priorities, Parus blends refined aesthetics, comfort and adaptability, becoming a home in which contrasting rhythms of family life and family members converge and revel in their own resort-like retreat.
